description: Fork of exp650 (E=384 single-final residual_lut = 1.4825 @ 86.51M). Architectural ablation: remove residual_lut ENTIRELY. The final E embedding (post-block, after E-residual skips) is LN'd and fed directly into the unembedder Linear(E=384, V). D=384 dimension goes unused. Removes 9.44M params (the single final_residual_lut). Expected total params ~77.07M. Tests how much we lose without ANY residual_lut — the E carry alone has to encode predictive signal. Reference: exp650 = 1.4825 (single-final resid_lut), exp651 = 1.4813 (per-layer resid_lut), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
